verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs show an Android experience, with 'Hey Google' screen-aware help, and refer to a Gemini mobile app. They also note that some mobile app features are not available to work or school accounts, which is a caveat for knowledge-workers. Missing for 10: any evidence of an official iOS app, documentation of the mobile feature set and parity with web/desktop, and independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile apps.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: On Android, say “Hey Google” to ask Gemini for help with what’s on your screen
If you have access to Gemini Apps with a work or school account, some Gemini mobile app features aren’t available.
